ja: 忙しかったけど、友達と近況を話せたよ。
en: Though I was busy, I caught up with friends.
alternatives: Although I was busy, I caught up with friends.
I was busy, but I caught up with friends.
point: though の後に but は重ねない

ja: 知ってたら、ケンに手伝ってって頼んだのに。
en: I'd have asked Ken to help if I'd known.
alternatives: If I'd known, I'd have asked Ken to help.
Had I known, I'd have asked Ken for help.
point: 過去の仮定は had + 過去分詞、頼むは ask + 人 + to do

ja: 子どもの頃は、私、速く走れたんだ。
en: I could run fast as a kid.
alternatives: As a kid, I could run fast.
I could run fast as a child.
point: 過去にできたことは could。can の過去形を使う

ja: 最近、ずっと夜更かしして働きすぎなんだ。
en: I've been burning the candle at both ends lately.
alternatives: I've been overdoing it lately, working late every night.
I've been working late and overdoing it lately.
point: 「ずっと〜している」は現在完了進行形。idiom も覚えよう

ja: 雨がやんだら、歩いて行くよ。
en: I'll walk when the rain stops.
alternatives: When the rain stops, I'll walk.
I'll walk once the rain stops.
point: 未来のことでも when 節は現在形 stops

ja: 土曜は夫婦で川沿いを散歩して、途中でカフェに寄ったよ。
en: We strolled along the river Saturday, ducking into a café.
alternatives: We walked by the river Saturday and stopped at a café.
Saturday we took a riverside stroll, popping into a café.
point: 「〜して、途中で寄った」は , ducking into のように -ing でつなぐ

ja: 今週末の天気予報、もしかして知ってたりしない？
en: You wouldn't happen to know this weekend's forecast, would you?
alternatives: Do you happen to know the forecast for this weekend?
I don't suppose you know this weekend's forecast?
point: 「知ってたりしない？」は happen to や wouldn't で柔らかく

ja: 教えてくれたカフェ、行ってみたよ。
en: I tried the café you told me about.
alternatives: I checked out the café you mentioned.
I went to the café you recommended.
point: told me about の about を落とさない

ja: 近くに新しいカフェがあるよ。
en: There's a new cafe nearby.
alternatives: There's a new coffee shop nearby.
There's a new cafe near here.
point: 「〜がある」は There's で始める

ja: さっき電話したとき、運転してたの？
en: Were you driving when I called?
alternatives: Were you driving when I called you?
Were you behind the wheel when I called?
point: そのときしていた最中のことは過去進行形

ja: 外で雨が降ってるの、聞こえる？
en: Can you hear it raining outside?
alternatives: Can you hear the rain outside?
Can you hear the rain coming down?
point: 聞こえるは hear に can をつける

ja: 週末はどこに行ったの？
en: Where did you go this weekend?
alternatives: Where did you go on the weekend?
Where'd you go over the weekend?
point: 過去の疑問文は did + 動詞の原形

ja: 花火大会、雨で中止になったって。
en: I heard the fireworks got rained out.
alternatives: Apparently the fireworks were canceled because of rain.
I heard rain canceled the fireworks.
point: 「中止になった」は受け身で、rained out も使える

ja: 暑いね。窓、開けてもいい？
en: It's hot. Can I open the window?
alternatives: It's hot. May I open the window?
It's hot. Could I open the window?
point: Can I の後は動詞の原形

ja: 君の家の写真、見せてよ。
en: Show me photos of your house.
alternatives: Show me pictures of your house.
Show me pictures of your home.
point: 複数の写真は photos か pictures と複数形にする

ja: 何か読むものを探してるんだ。
en: I'm looking for something to read.
alternatives: I'm trying to find something to read.
I'm searching for something to read.
point: something の後ろに to read を置いて「読むもの」

ja: 今年は去年よりずっと暑いですね。
en: It's much hotter than last year.
alternatives: It's a lot hotter than last year.
It's way hotter than last year.
point: 比較級を強めるのは very ではなく much や a lot

ja: 一番よかったのは、家でのんびりしたことだよ。
en: What I liked best was just relaxing at home.
alternatives: What I enjoyed most was chilling at home.
The thing I liked best was relaxing at home.
point: 「一番〜なのは」は What I liked best was で始める

ja: あのとき、大阪から戻ったばかりだったよね？
en: You'd just gotten back from Osaka, right?
alternatives: You had just returned from Osaka then, right?
You'd just come back from Osaka, hadn't you?
point: 「戻ったばかりだった」は過去より前なので had just + 過去分詞

ja: もうこの街に慣れた？先月はまだ迷ってたよね。
en: Found your feet yet? You were still getting lost last month.
alternatives: Have you settled in yet? Last month you kept getting lost.
Have you found your feet yet? You were still lost last month.
point: 「慣れた？」は現在完了、先月の様子は過去進行形

ja: 雨だって言ってたのに、ずっと晴れてたね。
en: They said it would rain, but it was sunny.
alternatives: It was supposed to rain, but it stayed sunny.
The forecast said rain, but it stayed sunny.
point: said に合わせて will を would にする

ja: あのラーメン屋、いつも行列だよね。
en: There's always a line at that ramen place.
alternatives: That ramen place always has a line.
That ramen shop always has a long line.
point: 「行列ができてる」は There's a line で言える

ja: 君、日焼けしてる！暖かい所に行ったに違いない。
en: You're tanned. You must have gone somewhere warm.
alternatives: You're so tan! You must have gone somewhere warm.
You have a tan! You must've gone somewhere warm.
point: 過去の推量「〜したに違いない」は must have + 過去分詞

ja: 例のカフェ、行ってきたよ。もっと早く知りたかった！
en: I checked out that café. I wish I'd known sooner.
alternatives: I went to that café. If only I'd known sooner!
I tried that café. I wish I'd found out earlier.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish の後を過去完了 I'd known にする

ja: したいのは家でのんびりすることだよ。
en: What I want is to relax at home.
alternatives: I want to relax at home.
What I want is to chill at home.
point: 「〜したいこと」が主語。動詞は is で受ける

ja: 妹は毎週テニスをするよ。
en: My sister plays tennis every week.
alternatives: My sister plays tennis weekly.
My sister plays tennis each week.
point: 主語が三人称単数なので plays と s を付ける

ja: 新しいパン屋、何時に開くか知ってる？
en: Do you know when the new bakery opens?
alternatives: Any idea when the new bakery opens?
Know when the new bakery opens?
point: 間接疑問は主語＋動詞の語順で does は使わない

ja: 今夜は上着持っていくといいよ。
en: You should take a jacket tonight.
alternatives: You should bring a jacket tonight.
Tonight, you should take a coat.
point: 助言は should、have to だと強すぎる

ja: いつも晴れなら、ジョギングするのに。
en: If it were always sunny, I'd jog.
alternatives: I'd jog if it were always sunny.
If it was always sunny, I'd jog.
If it were always sunny, I'd go jogging.
point: 現実と違う仮定は if 節を過去形、主節は I'd＋動詞の原形

ja: 母は私に、もっと外に出てほしいんだ。
en: Mom wants me to go out more.
alternatives: My mother wants me to get out more.
My mom wants me to go outside more.
point: want + 人 + to do。me は目的格

ja: 今年の夏は暑いだけでなく、雨もほとんど降らなかった。
en: Not only was it hot this summer, it barely rained.
alternatives: It wasn't just hot this summer; it hardly rained either.
Not only was it hot this summer, but it hardly rained.
point: Not only が文頭なら was it と語順が逆になる
